pages.lesson:
LESSON: WRITING 10.5.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: THANK YOU AND CONGRATULATORY NOTES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.5: Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are strong emotions expressed in writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note
2. use the correct format to write a thank you note
3. write a congratulatory note correctly

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WRITING 10.5.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: THANK YOU AND CONGRATULATORY NOTES
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: WRITING 10.5.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: THANK YOU AND CONGRATULATORY NOTES
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note

What this means
In this part you learn to recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use the correct format to write a thank you note

What this means
In this part you learn to use the correct format to write a thank you note. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use the correct format to write a thank you note.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use the correct format to write a thank you note. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Write a congratulatory note correctly

What this means
In this part you learn to write a congratulatory note correctly. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: write a congratulatory note correctly.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can write a congratulatory note correctly. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes to a partner. (skill: use the correct format to write a thank you note)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: write a congratulatory note correctly)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note.
3. Practise this skill: use the correct format to write a thank you note.
4. Practise this skill: write a congratulatory note correctly.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are strong emotions expressed in writing?
2. Why should one write how they feel about something?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Writing 10.5.1 Functional Writing: Thank you and Congratulatory notes means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: recognise the key elements and layout of a thank you and a congratulatory note.
5. Be able to: use the correct format to write a thank you note.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
